visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A toddler girl with two braided pigtails, wearing a grey t-shirt featuring a cartoon bear and khaki shorts, is playing on a light-colored wooden floor. She has a yellow and blue toy stethoscope around her neck and interacts with an adult sitting in a white office chair. A red toy medical bag and a basket of colorful blocks are nearby. (2) The girl uses the stethoscope to 'examine' the adult's stomach. The setting is a clean, indoor home environment with a white air purifier and a printer in the background. The lighting is bright and natural. (3) The toddler squats to rummage through her red toy bag, picking up small plastic cups and a toy syringe. She looks up at the adult with a focused, serious facial expression. (4) A close-up shot focuses on the girl's face as she holds a small transparent medicine cup, her eyes directed downward toward the adult's leg. (5) The girl uses a toy ear thermometer on another adult with bleached blonde hair who is sitting on the floor. She performs the action with deliberate, careful movements. (6) The girl holds a wooden toy syringe, looking at it curiously before attempting to 'administer' an injection to the adult's arm. (7) She takes out a small clear plastic bag containing colorful toy pills from her red bag and hands it to the adult. (8) A final static screen appears with a pink background, featuring a cartoon illustration of the girl and the text 'POPO'S DAILY LIFE'.
